profile.headline: Software Developer at Availity
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer who strives for continuous improvement in all things involving software development. The journey never ends.

Before starting my professional career as a developer, I  served in the U.S Army where I had an incredible experience doing things and meeting people that I will cherish for the rest of my life. One of those things was graduating the U.S Army Ranger School. The kind of leadership skills that are developed in a graduate from this school are priceless in any career field and I strive to apply those skills wherever and whenever I can as a software developer.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description: Assist other development teams with whatever software-related things they may need assistance with.

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description:
• Collaborated with a UX Design team to improve the user interface of a British county fair promotion and information website.
• Developed full stack applications under strict deadlines and pushed them to surge and Heroku.
• Proficient with chrome developer tools, Javascript debugger, and Ruby byebug for code debugging.

positions.title: Line Supervisor
positions.description:
•Effectively maintained a company excel sheet tracking individual personnel equipment resulting in 110 personnel avoiding owing money to the U.S. Army.
•Recommended modification of the company equipment allocation procedure resulting in the improved maintenance of equipment and prolonging the life of $40,000 worth of company equipment.
• Successfully Trained other Team leaders on proper employee performance appraisal techniques and established a standard operating procedure for performance appraisal within my department.

projects.title: abook
projects.description: Keep track of those books! This site will allow you to create a list of books that you are planning on reading. You can attach notes to your current book and after you're done reading just hit the "finished" button to send that book to the "finished" section of your profile. Created with a React front-end and a Rails back-end.

projects.title: undisclosed
projects.description: Ever wish you knew about secret or otherwise largely unknown places in your city that you know exist but have no idea what or where they are? All cities, no matter how small, have cool and quirky places that most people don't know about. Create an account in this app to look at or create blogs about unknown places in your city that other users have posted. If you're interested in exploring another city you can look at the posts that people from that city have posted. Created with a React front-end and an Express back-end.
